subject: reasoning
question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word FORCING is arranged in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
Given word: 'FORCING'

After arranged in alphabetical order:

 
 

 Alphabets
 F
 O
 R
 C
 I
 N
 G
 
 

 Alphabetical order
 C
 F
 G
 I
 N
 O
 R
 
 

After arranged in alphabetical order,

No letter will remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
